reader.requirement: At --std 85, a literal in the BY phrase of any VARYING or AFTER level of PERFORM Format 4 must not be zero, whatever the varied operand, and the compiler must refuse it; a nonzero (including negative) literal is legal.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.PerformVaryingInitInnerBeforeAugmentOuter: run-time augment order, not the BY-literal screen
perform-varying-by-omitted-2002: an omitted BY is refused at 1985, so a BY phrase is always written there

COBOL2120: BY operand 'ZERO' violates ... shall not be zero
probes.expected: refused (a zero BY literal, or not a numeric literal at all under SR5)

reader.notes: The zero test reads the literal value (decimal parse, sign applied by Classify), so every spelling of zero is caught at every level, and figurative ZERO is caught too. Same code at every edition.
